metadata.article_title: Orders and notices to be in writing.

article.title: Orders and notices to be in writing.
article.content: All orders and notices served on or given to any person under the provisions of this Code shall be in writing.
article.html:
142Orders and notices to be in writing.

Section 142

All orders and notices served on or given to any person under the provisions of this Code shall be in writing.
